description: 5 negative webhook parity cases (workflow-test.MD Section J, 2026-09-10 cycle).

cases.name: basic_auth without credentials
cases.notes: The workflow requires basic auth; an anonymous request must be rejected with 401 on both hosts.

cases.name: token_auth without bearer
cases.notes: JWT-protected webhook; a missing bearer token must be rejected with 401.

cases.name: unknown webhook path
cases.notes: An unregistered webhook path must answer 404 on both hosts.

cases.name: token_auth with invalid bearer
cases.notes: A malformed bearer token must be rejected with 401.

cases.name: basic_auth with wrong credentials
cases.notes: Wrong basic-auth credentials must be rejected with 401.
